summary: refactor(shared): move fxa-shared payments to the subscriptions-legacy lib
description:
Because:

* fxa-shared/payments must leave fxa-shared so the package can go.
* Callers use instanceof on the moved classes, so they move with no shim.

This commit:

* Moves fxa-shared/payments to libs/accounts/subscriptions-legacy.
* Adds the fxa-shared ILogger to the lib as log.ts.
* Points the 28 auth-server and admin-server importers at the lib.
* Removes the fxa-shared payments exports and ports the iap util test.
* Adds googleapis to the root dependencies.

Closes FXA-10668
